info.title: Aero Zenith Flow API
info.description:
Space Scope backend. JSON responses use `{ data, meta }`; errors use `{ error, meta }`.

Authentication endpoints under `/api/auth/*` are served by Better Auth and follow its protocol.

Health probes (`/health/live`, `/health/ready`) return a fixed `{ status }` shape.

get.summary: The signed-in user's identity and profile
Roles, memberships and the app-gate status for the signed-in user
Server-sent events: `changed` whenever the caller's roles or memberships change

200.description: Event stream: `ready` on connect, `changed` on access changes, comment heartbeats every 25s

post.summary: Invite a person to projects or accounts (admins only)
Issue a fresh link for a pending invitation and email it again
Describe an invitation by token (public; identical answer for unknown tokens)
Create a password account for an invited email and accept the invitation (public)
Accept an invitation addressed to the signed-in user's email

get.summary: Resume point of the self-serve onboarding wizard

post.summary: Create (or rename) the caller's workspace and make them its account admin
Create (or update) the first project of the caller's workspace

get.summary: Accounts visible to the caller (administered or containing one of their projects)

post.summary: Create an account (account admins and super admins)

get.summary: Accounts the caller administers, with their projects

patch.summary: Rename an account or change its slug

delete.summary: Delete an account; `force=true` also deletes its projects

get.summary: Accounts the caller administers and their other project memberships, with counts
Projects the caller can read, newest first (archived ones included)

post.summary: Create a project in an account the caller administers

get.summary: Ticket, sprint and member counts for visible projects

delete.summary: Permanently delete a project and its content (account admins)

post.summary: Archive a project (read-only, hidden from members)
Move a project to another account (admin of both accounts)

get.summary: People who can access the project: members and account admins (no archived users or super admins)
Rate card rows for the given visible projects
Names and avatars for the given users, limited to people the caller shares a project or account with

duplicate.description: True when a pending invitation already covers this email and scope; nothing was sent
